text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Lembaga Perindustrian Kayu Malaysia (Pemerbadanan) (Tahap Pembebasan

Formaldehid daripada Produk Berasaskan Panel) 2025.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 2 Februari 2026.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna

yang lain—

"formaldehid" ertinya gas beracun, tidak berwarna dan berbau sengit dan

digunakan sebagai pengawet dalam sintesis kimia dan dalam pembuatan resin sintetik;

"pengangkutan" ertinya pengangkutan produk berasaskan panel dari

Negeri Sabah atau Sarawak ke Semenanjung Malaysia atau ke Wilayah Persekutuan

Labuan melalui darat, laut atau udara;

"pengeluar" ertinya seseorang yang mengeluarkan atau mengilang dan

menjalankan aktiviti sebagai pedagang bagi produk berasaskan panel bagi maksud

pasaran dalam negeri;

"pengangkut" ertinya seseorang yang mengangkut produk berasaskan panel dari

Negeri Sabah atau Sarawak ke Semenanjung Malaysia atau ke Wilayah Persekutuan

Labuan melalui darat, laut atau udara;

"produk berasaskan panel" ertinya produk panel yang diperbuat daripada kayu

atau bahan lignoselulosa lain dalam bentuk sama ada venir, serpai, partikel, kepingan

atau gentian yang diproses menggunakan perekat sintetik sebagaimana yang

disenaraikan dalam Jadual Pertama.

Kewajipan untuk mematuhi tahap pembebasan formaldehid daripada

produk berasaskan panel

3. Mana-mana pengeluar, pengimport dan pengangkut hendaklah mematuhi

tahap pembebasan formaldehid sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang pertama

Jadual Kedua.

Pengujian tahap pembebasan formaldehid daripada produk berasaskan panel

4. Bagi maksud peraturan 3, pengeluar, pengimport dan pengangkut hendaklah—

(a) menjalankan pengujian tahap pembebasan formaldehid daripada

produk berasaskan panel mengikut standard yang ditetapkan dalam

Jadual Kedua;

(b) memastikan pengujian tahap pembebasan formaldehid daripada

produk berasaskan panel dijalankan di makmal yang telah memperoleh

akreditasi daripada badan akreditasi kebangsaan yang merupakan

ahli kepada Asia Pacific Accreditation Cooperation (APAC) atau

International Laboratory Accreditation Cooperation (ILAC); dan

(c) memastikan laporan pengujian tahap pembebasan formaldehid diperoleh

setelah pengujian itu dijalankan atas produk berasaskan panel.

Kewajipan untuk mengemukakan laporan pengujian tahap pembebasan

formaldehid daripada produk berasaskan panel

5. Laporan pengujian tahap pembebasan formaldehid yang dinyatakan di bawah

perenggan 4(c) hendaklah dikemukakan kepada Lembaga oleh—

(a) pengeluar mengikut tatacara yang ditentukan oleh Lembaga;

(b) pengimport bagi permohonan suatu permit import; atau

(c) pengangkut bagi pengesahan borang sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh

Lembaga bagi maksud pengangkutan.

Penalti

6. Mana-mana pengeluar, pengimport atau pengangkut yang melanggar mana-mana

peruntukan Peraturan-Peraturan ini melakukan suatu kesalahan dan boleh, apabila

disabitkan, didenda tidak melebihi satu ratus ribu ringgit.

MALAYSIAN TIMBER INDUSTRY BOARD (INCORPORATION) ACT 1973

MALAYSIAN TIMBER INDUSTRY BOARD (INCORPORATION) (FORMALDEHYDE

EMISSION LEVEL FROM PANEL BASED PRODUCT) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 34(2)(f) of

the Malaysian Timber Industry Board (Incorporation) Act 1973 [Act 105], the Board,

with the approval of the Minister, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Timber Industry Board

(Incorporation) (Formaldehyde Emission Level from Panel Based Product)

Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 2 February 2026.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—

"formaldehyde" means a poisonous, colourless and intense smelling gas and

is used as a preservative in chemical synthesis and in the making of synthetic resins;

"transportation" means transportation of panel based product from the States of

Sabah or Sarawak to Peninsular Malaysia or to the Federal Territory of Labuan by land,

sea or air;

"manufacturer" means a person who produces or manufactures and carries out

an activity as a trader of panel based product for the purposes of domestic market;

"transporter" means a person who transport panel based product from the States

of Sabah or Sarawak to Peninsular Malaysia or to the Federal Territory of Labuan by land,

sea or air;

"panel based product" means panel products made of timber or other

lignocellulose material in the form of veneers, flakes, particles, pieces or fibers processed

using synthetic adhesives as listed in the First Schedule.

Duty to comply with formaldehyde emission level from panel based product

3. Any manufacturer, importer and transporter shall comply with the formaldehyde

emission level as specified in the first column of the Second Schedule.

Testing of formaldehyde emission level from panel based product

4. For the purposes of regulation 3, the manufacturer, importer and

transporter shall—

(a) carry out formaldehyde emission level test from panel based product

in accordance with standards as specified in the Second Schedule;

(b) ensure the testing of formaldehyde emission level from panel based

product is carried out in the laboratories that have obtained accreditation

from the national accreditation body that is a member of the Asia Pacific

Accreditation Cooperation (APAC) or International Laboratory

Accreditation Cooperation (ILAC); and

(c) ensure a test report on the formaldehyde emission level is obtained after

the test is carried out on the panel based product.

Duty to submit formaldehyde emission level from panel based product test report

5. The test report on the formaldehyde emission level specified under

paragraph 4(c) shall be submitted to the Board by—

(a) the manufacturer in accordance with the procedure determined

by the Board;

(b) the importer for the application of an import license; or

(c) the transporter for the verification form as determined by the Board

for the purposes of transportation.

Penalty

6. Any manufacturer, importer or transporter who contravenes any provision

of these Regulations commits an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine

not exceeding one hundred thousand ringgit.
